review: 701.47a-1: decision text about choosing among several Armies was garbled; restated.

701.47b-1, 701.47c-1: base decisions now say B passes (B holds Counterspell); 701.47b-1 base expected now orders the token's state-based death before the reflexive trigger goes on the stack and takes the 0 damage from last known power.

scenarios.title: Amass creates an Army token only if the player controls none, then puts counters on an Army

setup.notes: In the has_zombie_army and has_orc_army variants the token is on A's battlefield at the start.

decisions: A casts Lazotep Plating (Amass Zombies 1), tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Lazotep Plating resolves. Where A already controls an Army, A chooses that Army.

variants.label: no_army
variants.expected: A creates a 0/0 black Zombie Army creature token and puts one +1/+1 counter on it. A controls exactly one Army: a 1/1 Zombie Army token.

variants.label: has_zombie_army
variants.delta: A controls a Zombie Army token with two +1/+1 counters.
variants.expected: No new token is created. The existing Zombie Army gets a +1/+1 counter and is 3/3 with three counters. A controls exactly one Army.

variants.label: has_orc_army
variants.delta: A controls an Orc Army token with one +1/+1 counter.
variants.expected: No new token is created. The Orc Army gets a +1/+1 counter and becomes a Zombie in addition to its other types: it is a 2/2 Orc Zombie Army with two counters.

scenarios.title: A player amasses even when no counter can be put on the Army
decisions: A casts Foray of Orcs (Amass Orcs 2; when you do, it deals X damage to target creature an opponent controls, where X is the amassed Army's power), tapping all four Mountains.
B passes; Foray of Orcs resolves. The when-you-do trigger, if it fires, targets Craw Wurm and resolves.

variants.label: counters_prevented
variants.expected: With Solemnity on the battlefield A creates a 0/0 Orc Army token but no counters can be put on it. A has still amassed, so the when-you-do trigger fires. The 0/0 token dies to state-based actions before the trigger is put on the stack, and on resolution the trigger deals 0 damage to Craw Wurm (the token's last known power): Craw Wurm has no damage marked.

variants.label: no_solemnity
variants.delta: Solemnity is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: A creates a 0/0 Orc Army token and puts two +1/+1 counters on it (2/2). The when-you-do trigger fires and deals 2 damage to Craw Wurm, which has 2 damage marked and survives. The token stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: foray_countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell on Foray of Orcs, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Foray of Orcs is countered and goes to A's graveyard. A does not amass, no token is created and no trigger fires. Craw Wurm has no damage marked.

scenarios.forge_notes: The reflexive trigger in Forge is an ImmediateTrigger gated on the remembered Army, which is set before counters are placed.

scenarios.title: The amassed Army is the chosen creature whether or not it received counters
decisions: A casts Foray of Orcs (Amass Orcs 2; when you do, it deals X damage to target creature an opponent controls, where X is the amassed Army's power), tapping all four Mountains.
B passes; Foray of Orcs resolves; A's only Army is the Orc Army token. The when-you-do trigger targets Craw Wurm and resolves.

variants.label: counters_prevented
variants.expected: Solemnity stops the two counters, so the Orc Army token stays 3/3. It is still the amassed Army: the trigger deals 3 damage to Craw Wurm (6/4), which survives with 3 damage marked.

variants.label: no_solemnity
variants.delta: Solemnity is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: The Orc Army token gets two +1/+1 counters and is 5/5. The trigger deals 5 damage to Craw Wurm, which dies and goes to B's graveyard.

variants.label: foray_countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell on Foray of Orcs, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Foray of Orcs is countered and goes to A's graveyard. A does not amass: the Orc Army token stays 3/3 and Craw Wurm has no damage marked.
